description: No referral made for nephrology consultation despite stable Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 3.
evidence_in_history: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 3 noted with stable eGFR around 44-45 mL/min/1.73m²; no mention of nephrology referral or consultation.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up instructions state no referral made for nephrology consultation despite stable CKD.
suggested_correction: Arrange nephrology referral for ongoing CKD management and monitoring.

description: No ophthalmology follow-up arranged for diabetic retinopathy monitoring.
evidence_in_history: History lists diabetic retinopathy (mild non-proliferative) diagnosed in 2019 with no recent ophthalmology follow-up.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up instructions indicate no documented ophthalmology follow-up for diabetic retinopathy progression monitoring.
suggested_correction: Schedule regular ophthalmology visits to monitor diabetic retinopathy progression.

description: Follow-up visits with cardiology and endocrinology clinics scheduled only in 6 months, which may delay timely reassessment given suboptimal diabetes and lipid control and recent CHF exacerbation.
evidence_in_history: Prior plans called for 3-month follow-up; diabetes remains poorly controlled with HbA1c 7.8% and lipids above targets.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge instructions schedule follow-up in 6 months with cardiology and endocrinology, potentially delaying care.
suggested_correction: Advise earlier follow-up visits (e.g., within 1-3 months) to reassess volume status, glycemic and lipid control.

description: No adjustment or intensification of glucose-lowering therapy despite elevated fasting glucose (145 mg/dL) and HbA1c (7.8%).
evidence_in_history: Diabetes documented with suboptimal glucose control; insulin dose unchanged during hospitalization.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary notes no insulin dose adjustment despite elevated glucose and HbA1c above target.
suggested_correction: Consider diabetes medication adjustment or intensification, including insulin titration or addition of other agents, with documented plan.

description: Statin therapy continued without lipid goal reassessment or adjustment despite persistent elevated LDL (135 mg/dL).
evidence_in_history: Lipid panel shows LDL elevated at 135 mg/dL, above target <100 mg/dL despite atorvastatin 40 mg daily.
evidence_in_summary: No documentation of lipid goal reassessment or any medication dose adjustment for dyslipidemia.
suggested_correction: Reassess lipid goals and consider statin dose escalation or addition of other lipid-lowering agents if indicated.

description: No documented plan for electrolyte monitoring despite increased furosemide dose and elevated potassium at high normal level.
evidence_in_history: Furosemide dose increased from 40 mg to 60 mg; potassium at 4.9 mmol/L (high normal).
evidence_in_summary: No documented electrolyte monitoring plan post-discharge.
suggested_correction: Establish regular electrolyte and renal function monitoring to manage risk of hypokalemia/hyperkalemia and renal deterioration.

description: Patient education regarding orthostatic hypotension precautions not reinforced despite prior reported dizziness and orthostatic hypotension findings.
evidence_in_history: Prior visit document noted orthostatic BP drop and dizziness upon standing.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge notes lack documentation of education reinforcement on orthostatic hypotension.
suggested_correction: Reinforce orthostatic hypotension precautions and provide patient education at discharge.

description: Immunization status not reviewed or updated during hospitalization.
evidence_in_history: No mention of immunization review or updates in any prior notes.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary notes immunization status not reviewed or updated.
suggested_correction: Review immunization status (e.g., influenza, pneumococcal, COVID-19) and update as appropriate before discharge.

description: No documented referral to diabetes educator or dietitian despite ongoing diabetes management challenges.
evidence_in_history: Plans include reinforcement of diabetic diet and glucose monitoring, but no formal referral documented.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary notes lifestyle counseling provided but no documented referral to diabetes educator or dietitian.
suggested_correction: Arrange referral to diabetes educator and/or dietitian for structured support in diabetes self-management.

description: No documentation of advanced care planning or goals of care discussion despite chronic progressive illnesses.
evidence_in_history: Patient has multiple chronic progressive conditions (CHF, CKD, diabetes) but no recorded advance care planning.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary explicitly notes no documentation of advanced care planning or goals of care discussions.
suggested_correction: Initiate and document advanced care planning and goals of care discussions as part of comprehensive chronic disease management.
